items.title: Stylish Summer
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
It's time for some fun in the sun! Get ready for summer with these fashionable summer skins!
- 10 unique skins
- by SleepyK0

items.title: Winged Demons
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
These are no ordinary teens, they're ready to take flight! Show off your rebellious side with these neon demon skins!
- 10 unique skins
- by Zombeanie

items.title: Clown Kidz
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
It's time to clown around with these wacky characters! These skins are perfect for goofing off with your friends!
- 10 unique skins
- by Kyuuri

items.title: Animal Hoodies
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Wear a cute animal hoodie and look absolutely adorable while doing it! If you love the new axolotl or fox mob then this pack has the perfect skin for you! These teens in hoodies have a variety of animals and colorful designs to choose from! 

- Includes 10 skins
- Dino, shark, bear, frog and more!
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Unspeakable Underwater Bunker
items.creator: Meatball Inc
items.description:
Sneak into Unspeakable's top secret underwater base! Hidden deep underground, the base is filled with security gadgets, vehicles, furniture, and automatic farms! Mine resources to trade for helicopters, submarines, and more! Explore the custom terrain for secret locations and hidden treasures!

- 5 vehicles
- 5 auto farms
- 60+ furniture options
- 25+ Unspeakable skins

items.title: Teen Axolotl Hats
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Watch out! The cutest teens on the server just stepped into Minecraft with stylish axolotl mob hats! Perfect for looking cute and fashionable around your friends in game! 

- 12 axolotl teen hat skins!
- Bright and colorful!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Elemental Anime
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Become elemental with earth, fire, ice, water, flower, and wind skins! Show off in style which anime element skin best suits your powerful spiritual side! 

- 6 epic elemental HD skins! 
- Perfect for Anime roleplay! 
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Tropical Teens
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
These teens are feeling relaxed and breezy under the bright sun! Step into paradise with these tropical skins!

+ 12 skins to choose from

items.title: Halloween Skins
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Halloween has arrived! Choose your favorite of the scariest and coolest skins now and and go ghost hunting!

+ 10 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Halloween themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Halloween Legends
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
It's spooky season, Halloween is finally there! Choose your favorite skin for Halloween and go trick-or-treating! Your friends and other players will love your skin!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Halloween themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Medieval City Adventure
items.creator: MrAniman2
items.description:
In this adventure you will have to find secret rooms, open gates, parkour, fight unseen mobs and take back the city from the monsters! Can you reach the top level and find out who leads all the monsters in the city? Custom music will accompany you on your adventure.

+ Quests
+ New Mobs
+ Huge Medieval City
+ Single & Multiplayer
+ Secret Easter Egg
+ New Music
+ 7 Skins

items.title: Ultimate Apocalypse Bunker
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Want to be ultra safe from the zombie apocalypse? Then pick this Ultimate Apocalypse Bunker! Activate lasers, drones, TNT cannons, flamethrowers and more to protect yourself from these zombies! There is no other bunker as safe as this one!

+Animated entry door!
+Completely furnished!
+Unique player keycard!
+All weapons are activatable!
+Includes a helicopter!

items.title: Camo Blocks: Trees
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Move through the trees undetected and be perfectly camouflaged with nature! Hide from your friends and become the ultimate ninja!

- 8 camo block skins!
- Includes: Oak tree, birch tree, acacia tree, spruce tree, oak logs, oak leaves, spruce leaves, birch logs!

items.title: Royal Mermaids
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description:
Have you ever wondered who ruled the oceans? Well wonder no more, these royals reign the seas! Everyone knows that everything is better under water.
Do you have what it takes to be a ruler of the seven seas? Roleplay as royal mermaids with this skin pack!

items.title: Teen Pets
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Nothing is better than showing your pet you love them. These teens are wearing the cutest clothing to show their love for their pets! A perfect skin pack for cute hoodie lovers!

items.title: Dream Colors
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Dream big with colorful fashion! First build the space ship, fly to the sky. Then start dreaming!

+ Multiple options to choose from
+ Bright
+ Fun
+ Skins

items.title: Lucky Block Adventure
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Lucky Block Adventure is a world filled with tons of lucky blocks!
There are endless outcomes and opportunities when you break these mysterious blocks. One outcome might be positive while another might harm you! Can you defeat the Ender Dragon with the random loot you gather? Good luck!

+ Single player or multiplayer

items.title: Skyblock Bugs
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Skyblock on a bug themed world! Adventure across the floating islands, gather loot, and defeat the Ender Dragon!
This world is a great survival challenge for anyone brave enough. Don't let the giant spider scare you!
+ Single player and multiplayer

items.title: Skyblock Lucky Blocks
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Skyblock Lucky Blocks! Lucky blocks are added to the skyblock world!
Travel to all the mysterious floating islands and break open the random lucky blocks that spawn on them. Find the eyes of ender and defeat the Ender Dragon. A great challenge awaits, are you ready?

+ Single player and multiplayer

items.title: Arabian Castle
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Take a flight on a magic carpet, or spend the day taming lizards! Explore the grand palace and become royalty - or live in the furnished village below.

+ Includes furniture models
+ 4 stylish skins
+ 1 FREE skin
+ Great for roleplay

items.title: Demonic Souls
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
As night comes in the lonely woods, where grass has become shadowed by the tall trees, the glowing eyes of the demonic souls appear. Will you have the courage to haunt the night once more with these demonic souls! Become fear itself with these epic skins!

- 8 dark and demonic skins!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Black and White
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Nothing beats the classics. From a simple mime to a crazy jester, the possibilities are endless. Nothing monochrome about this pack, what will you choose?

items.title: Cool Ghoul
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: It's that time of the year when the cool ghouls come out to scare! In this skin pack you'll find these teens are roleplaying as some spooky monsters. Become a ghost or zombified teen and haunt your friends where ever they go!

items.title: Floral Bees
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Buzz! Buzz! This skin pack is working hard to make the world a better place, one flower at a time. Will you help the cause?
